verdict.rationale: Self-hosting a design platform under an open-source license is a fair question for a design tool, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Figma offering self-hosting or open-source licensing. The open-source repos cited (Code Connect, the REST API spec) are developer tooling, not the platform itself, and the remote MCP server and REST API are cloud services.

support.subject: As a developer, I can self-host the full design platform on my own infrastructure under an open-source license
